definitions.cell: One framework/pin/mode/path/operation/context populated-empty pair; pilot uses case in place of operation/context.
definitions.overall: Current executable native paths only: Rails current, Drizzle current, Django current, Alembic auto, Prisma stable. Raw paths and Alembic always remain separately tabulated.
definitions.prisma: Latest tag 8.0.0-rc.22 is unsupported in the retained matrix; executable stable pin is 7.10.0.
definitions.executions: Count retained trial executions, not requested or unsupported cells. Rails fixes excludes copied comparisons and atomicity embedded from its separate experiment.
definitions.detectors: Coverage is conditional on populated silent loss; empty invariants include intended-change checks. Lint availability is reported separately.
definitions.lint_false_alarms: Counts of preserved or fully rolled-back loud rebuilding cells with any available lint finding, not statistical specificity rates. Loud-partial is excluded. Runtime rebuild is used when known; Prisma uses planned_rebuild because its runtime trace is unavailable. Eligible denominators exclude unavailable lint.
definitions.lint_specific: SQLD001 must name a child table with a recorded FK of the reported action to the named rebuilt parent. For CASCADE the child must have an R/D violation and fewer rows; for SET NULL and SET DEFAULT, which only the later build reports, its content digest must have changed. SQLD003 must name the missing index/trigger or violated trigger behavior. SQLD002 is generic even in a cell with row loss. Specific, GenericOnly and Unmatched partition flagged silent-loss cells; mixed specific and SQLD002 counts as specific.
definitions.silent_loss_types: SilentRowOrValue has R/D violations, including mixed row/object losses. SilentObjectOnly has O/T/K/V violations without R/D. SilentOther retains any remaining cases. These categories partition silent-loss cells.
definitions.current_operations: OperationsEvaluated and OperationsWithSilentLoss count distinct framework-operation pairs, so Overall is the sum across frameworks. Existing Operations counts distinct operation names across its scope.
definitions.fk_action_change: Changed ON UPDATE/DELETE actions on surviving FKs are reported separately from context classes and can overlap them; absent FKs alone do not count as changed actions.
definitions.atomicity: Only a partial commit in a transactional scenario is an atomicity failure; no-transaction controls are separate.
definitions.realworld: Synthetic replays are not production incidents. Silent losses exclude the explicitly superseded Zpan index. Implicit-object and row/FK-value counts can overlap; exclusive and intersection counts are supplied.
definitions.relint: The author used the matrix results to develop sqlite-doctor 2bf86dc and then ran that build on the same Current cells. Reconstructed inputs reproduced every recorded lint result with the recorded build (scripts/relint.py --verify). LintRuleFalseAlarm excludes the generic SQLD002.
definitions.rerun: Repeated on 2026-11-01 with unchanged fixtures. Release-candidate counts exclude drop_unique, whose fixture schema is not the starting schema Kit 1.0 generates; raw-tx is the generated SQL in one transaction.
definitions.oracle: Seeded raw-path controls (scripts/oracle_validation.py). Limitation scope holds the controls built to expose blind spots: unintended default changes on an ordinary matrix fixture and a changed value in a derived table without an id column; Matrix scope holds the other controls on matrix fixtures.
definitions.rails_base: Rails pins built from each pull request's base commit on Ruby 3.4.3, run with the same operation matrix and atomicity scenarios as the pull-request pins.
definitions.atlas: Atlas Community migration analyzers from a digest-pinned image on the four sqlite-doctor inputs. Unavailable inputs could not be replayed by Atlas (statements on tables or indexes the input does not define, framework bookkeeping queries in Rails and Django traces, other replay errors) or had no trace (Prisma); they are never counted as clean. Flagged means at least one diagnostic of any kind.
definitions.rebuild: Rebuilding cells follow the classification of the 2026-11-21 re-analysis: a table counts as rebuilt when it is dropped after its rows were copied into a table created in the same SQL. The flags stored in the result files used a looser rule (any CREATE TABLE with any DROP TABLE); the cells that differ are listed in results/reanalysis-2026-11-21/rebuild_classification.json.
definitions.tracker: Counts are labeled issue/PR records, not deduplicated underlying bugs; real-data-loss incidents use the explicit adjudicated ID list.

realworld.reason: The lost index was intentionally superseded by the migration.
